points.description: States that there is an open path (an open/complete/unbroken circuit or route, so current/flow/movement can pass). Equivalent wording such as 'the circuit was complete/closed' or 'a continuous path was available' earns the mark. Answers that give no reference to a path/complete route (e.g. only 'it was connected wrongly' or 'because of a fault') do not earn the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that an open (continuous, available) path existed, or an equivalent such as a complete circuit. No marks for vague or unrelated reasons that do not mention a path or route.
